quests.title: A Card by Hand
quests.summary: Take a birthday card to Pier Street House in time, since the post is no use, and hear how it landed.

steps.text: Deliver the card in Pier Street House.
steps.line: A card! In this weather! Tell them I'm touched, and that they still can't spell my name.

steps.text: Take the reply back to Student Digs.
steps.line: She said that? Ha. Right, I'll write back. Meanwhile, this is for you.

start.ask: Wel, it's a birthday card for my old mate in Pier Street House, and the post would take a fortnight. Would you hand it over?
start.accept: Tell her it's from the best-looking person in Student Digs. She'll know it's me.
